description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag 'StoreFooterlTag' that generates footer content for a store's web page, including the store's name and operational years.

classes.name: StoreFooterlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that outputs store footer information, including store name and years of operation.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates footer content, displaying the store's name and operational years based on business start date.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the tag processing, allowing page processing to continue.
